request.prompt: Animate this character in a Korean classroom scene. 3D anime-style render. COMPOSITION: The teacher character stands on the RIGHT SIDE of the frame, taking up roughly 30-35% of the horizontal width. She is visible from the waist up. A large green chalkboard fills the LEFT 65-70% of the frame behind her, with a clean empty writing surface. The camera is at a medium distance, eye-level, like a student sitting at a desk looking at the teacher. MOTION: The teacher smiles warmly, makes a gentle introducing gesture with her right hand pointing toward the chalkboard, and sways very slightly. Natural breathing motion, subtle blinking. Keep the chalkboard surface clean and empty — no text, no writing, no marks. Warm classroom lighting from above. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen format. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, logos, or watermarks anywhere in the image.
